grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: TOPIC 1.6.0
topics.description: This topic covers foundational vocabulary and descriptors, including colours as well as physical characteristics and personality traits in French.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.6.1 Colours
sub_topics.description: Focuses on colours as vocabulary for describing everyday objects, clothes, and food, while introducing grammar concepts such as gender and number agreement.

competencies.description: Express preferences for colours in French
Distinguish gender in colours

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.6.2 Physical Characteristics and Personality
sub_topics.description: Enhances learners' communication skills and confidence as they describe characteristics of a person and objects using adjectives related to traits in French.

competencies.description: Describe someone's physical characteristics and personality in French

topics.name: TOPIC 1.7.0 NUMERACY
topics.description: Numeracy refers to the ability to understand, interpret and work with numbers and mathematical concepts in daily practical communication. This topic covers Cardinal Numbers, Ordinal Numbers and Counting Money.

sub_topics.name: Sub - Topic 1.7.1 Cardinal Numbers 1-1000 in French
sub_topics.description: Covers cardinal numbers used constantly in everyday life when expressing age, quantity, prices, time, and dates.

competencies.description: Count from 0 - 1000 in French

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1. 7. 2 Ordinal Numbers
sub_topics.description: Teaches ordinal numbers to help learners indicate position, ranking, and order in instructions, sequences, and narratives.

competencies.description: Demonstrate knowledge of ordinal numbers from 1 to 20 in French

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1. 7. 3 Counting Money
sub_topics.description: Develops life skills in budgeting, saving, and financial decision-making alongside four mathematical operations in French.

competencies.description: Apply the four mathematical operations on numbers below 100 in French

topics.name: TOPIC 1.8.0 PREFERENCES
topics.description: Expressing preferences enables learners to share interests, build relationships, and discuss likes and dislikes across various social and cultural contexts.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.8.1 Likes and Dislikes
sub_topics.description: Focuses on expressions, verbs, and negative structures used to express opinions, likes, and dislikes with confidence.

competencies.description: Express likes and dislikes in French

topics.name: TOPIC 1.9.0 LOCALISATION AND MOVEMENT
topics.description: Discusses the position of an object, person, or thing in a sentence, equipping learners with vocabulary, expressions, and grammatical structures needed for describing position, direction, and distance.

sub_topics.name: Sub -Topic 1.9.1 Position
sub_topics.description: Defines the location or placement of an object, person, or point in relation to its surroundings.

competencies.description: Describe the position of an object in French
State the location of a person, place or thing in French

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.9.2 Direction
sub_topics.description: Provides instructions and guidance on how to navigate, ask for, and give directions from one place to another.

competencies.description: Give directions to someone in French

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.9.3 Distance
sub_topics.description: Covers French expressions used to indicate how far or near a location is during everyday travel conversations.

competencies.description: Indicate how far or near a point is from another in French

topics.name: TOPIC 1.10.0: ACCOMMODATION AND HYGIENE
topics.description: Links accommodation and hygiene with environmental awareness, enriching learners' French vocabulary regarding living spaces and maintaining personal and environmental health.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.10.1 Types of Homes
sub_topics.description: Explores modern and traditional homes, construction materials, and the names and uses of various rooms within a house.

competencies.description: Compare modern and traditional houses in French
Name different rooms and their use in a house

sub_topics.name: Sub- Topic 1.10.2 Care for the Surrounding
sub_topics.description: Focuses on hygiene behavioral changes, cleaning tools, maintaining clean surroundings, negative effects of dirty places, and personal hygiene.

competencies.description: Describe a clean and dirty place
Discuss personal hygiene

topics.name: Topic 1.11.0 Classroom Communication
topics.description: This topic covers classroom orders and instructions, school subjects, school timetables, and classroom objects.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.11.1 Classroom Orders and Instructions
sub_topics.description: Classroom orders and instructions are essential for creating a productive and supportive learning environment. A well ordered classroom minimizes distractions allowing learners to focus more on their studies. In this subtopic, learners will learn key phrases used by teachers and learners in a French speaking classroom such as common commands, instructions and questions that facilitate communication.

competencies.description: Use classroom orders and instructions in French.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.11.2 My School Subjects
sub_topics.description: This sub topic will enable learners to learn names of different school subjects in French and be able to express preferences about their favorite and least favorite subjects. The sub-topic will also introduce how to ask questions about subjects and discuss the subjects learners study.

competencies.description: Identify different school subjects in French.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.11.3 School Timetable
sub_topics.description: Planning is an important aspect of every person's daily activities. In this sub-topic, learners will learn how to plan for their daily activities and come up with timetables in French. A school timetable is a summarised plan that describes learners activities. It smoothly guides learners to pursue their academic activities without any stress. This sub-topic discusses school and personal timetable and classroom objects.

competencies.description: Draw up a school/personal time table
Describe different classroom objects.

topics.name: UNIT 12 TOPIC 1.12.0 DAILY ACTIVITIES
topics.description: Expressing daily activities is a universal concept that is relevant and relatable to all learners, regardless of their cultural background. This topic lays a foundation for everyday communication and helps learners to gain confidence in daily conversations, whether discussing their morning routines or leisure activities. It will enable learners to use key verbs and vocabulary while understanding the rhythm of daily life in French-speaking cultures. Thus, this topic will help learners understand the language and apply it to their real-life experiences and promote a more natural and practical use of French this topic has one sub-topic namely Telling Time

competencies.description: Develop basic conversational skills to clearly and confidently describe daily routines in French.
Engage in basic dialogues, asking and answering questions about daily routines.
Recognise and respond to emotions related to daily activities.
Express personal feelings and emotions.
Show empathy towards other people’s daily routines.
Compare and analyse different daily routines and habits among peers.
Reflect on how daily habits can influence language use and social interaction.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.12.1 Telling Time
sub_topics.description: Understanding how to tell time in French is a fundamental skill for learners. Time is an essential aspect of daily life, and knowing how to express it accurately enables learners to engage in a variety of everyday activities, from scheduling appointments to discussing plans and routines. In French, telling time differs slightly from English, particularly in expressing hours and minutes, as well as in the formal and informal structures used in conversations about time. This sub-topic will help learners not only learn how to read a clock in French but also understand the rhythm and structure of French time expressions.

competencies.description: Tell Time in French.
Narrate daily activities in French.
Identify days of the week and months of the year in French.

topics.name: UNIT 13 TOPIC 1 .13.0 THE PAST
topics.description: The past refers to a time that has already happened, before the present moment. It could be recent (yesterday, last week) or distant (years ago). The past usually means past tense and it is used to talk about actions or events that have already happened. In French, learners start by learning passé compose which is the most commonly used past tense in everyday conversations. It is used to talk about completed actions in the past. This topic introduces learners to time expressions often used with the past. It lays a foundation for expressing oneself more fully in French and leads to future learning of other past tenses like imparfait. The topic has one Sub-topic namely, Past Actions.

competencies.description: Develop communication skills by learning how to express past events share personal experiences and engage in conversations using the passé composé both in their spoken and written French.
Analyse sentence structures, choose between the correct helping verbs (avoir or être) and apply rules to various verbs and contexts.
Create short stories about past experiences, encouraging them to use their imagination.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.13.1 The Past Actions
sub_topics.description: Understanding past actions and the tenses used to describe them is essential as it allows learners to share their experiences, tell stories and connect events that shape their day to day lives. In this sub topic, learners will learn how to use le passé composé and l'imparfait to talk about completed actions in the past.

competencies.description: Describe past actions in French.

topics.name: UNIT 14 WEATHER 1.14.0
topics.description: The term weather encompasses a set of atmospheric conditions like temperature, rain, wind and sun that are observed at specific time in a particular place. The topic is essential for learners as it provides practical vocabulary and expressions useful in daily life. In French, discussing the weather not only helps the learners build their conversational skills but also enables them to engage in everyday interactions, whether making small talk with friends, checking the forecast, or planning activities. Understanding the weather introduces important grammar structures that help learners to practice both present tense and adjectives. This topic has three sub-topics namely, Weather conditions, Clothes and Activities and Factors affecting Weather.

competencies.description: Engage in basic conversations about the weather, providing an excellent opportunity to practice their listening and speaking skills.
Make observations, comparisons and predictions as they discuss how the weather impacts their daily lives or how it changes with the seasons.
Identify and interpret patterns in both the language and the world around them.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.14.1 Weather Conditions
sub_topics.description: Weather conditions refers to the temporary and local state of the atmosphere at a specific place and time, including factors such as: temperature, rain, clouds, wind. This sub-topic is essential for learners as it equips them with the basic vocabulary and expressions needed to describe the various weather conditions they encounter daily. The sub-topic will also enhance the learner's comprehension skills and enable them to discuss and respond appropriately in social situations. Furthermore, it will provide them with opportunities to practice adjectives and verbs in context, helping them to construct simple sentences.

competencies.description: Describe what the weather is like in French.
Identify various seasons in French.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.14.2 Clothes and Activities
sub_topics.description: Weather plays an important role in our daily lives. It influences our activities, mood, and clothes. Depending on the season, we adapt our clothes and activities to feel comfortable and enjoy the weather.

competencies.description: Describe activities and clothes associated with seasons in French.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.14.3 Factors affecting Weather
sub_topics.description: Weather is a complex phenomenon that is influenced by many factors such as atmospheric conditions, geographic factors and human activities. Understanding the factors that influence the weather is essential for predicting weather conditions and marking informed decisions to protect people and the world we live in.

competencies.description: Discuss factors affecting weather in Zambia
